VIETLANG 1: This course is the first in a three-quarter sequence and develops basic communication skills in everyday contexts. Grammatical structures and vocabulary are introduced through interpersonal, interpretive, and presentational modes of communication. Elements of Vietnamese culture are incorporated. A service-learning component introduces students to the local Vietnamese-speaking community through visits to community centers and engagement with guest speakers. This course is certified as a Cardinal Course by the Haas Center.
VIETLANG 2: Continuation of VIETLANG 1. This course is the second in a three-quarter sequence and builds on foundational skills to expand communication in a variety of contexts. Additional grammatical structures and vocabulary are introduced through interpersonal, interpretive, and presentational modes of communication. Elements of Vietnamese culture are incorporated. The service-learning component further develops students' engagement with the local Vietnamese-speaking community through continued visits and interactions with guest speakers. Prerequisite: VIETLANG 1 or by placement test. This course is certified as a Cardinal Course by the Haas Center.
VIETLANG 3: Continuation of VIETLANG 2. This third course in the sequence advances students' communication skills toward greater independence and confidence. More complex grammatical structures and expanded vocabulary are introduced through interpersonal, interpretive, and presentational modes of communication. Elements of Vietnamese culture are incorporated. The service-learning component encourages students to apply their language skills in meaningful interactions with the local Vietnamese-speaking community through community visits and guest speakers. Prerequisite: VIETLANG 2 or by placement test. This course is certified as a Cardinal Course by the Haas Center.
VIETLANG 21: Continuation of VIETLANG 3. This course is the first in a three-quarter sequence and integrates language and culture with an emphasis on developing proficiency in oral and written discourse. Targeted functional abilities include presentational and socio-culturally appropriate language in formal and informal contexts. A service-learning component introduces students to applying their developing Vietnamese language skills in guided, meaningful interactions with the local Vietnamese-speaking community through structured community visits and guest speakers. Prerequisite: VIETLANG 3 or by placement test. This course is certified as a Cardinal Course by the Haas Center.
VIETLANG 22: Continuation of VIETLANG 21. This second course in a three-quarter sequence continues to integrate language and culture, with an emphasis on expanding proficiency in oral and written discourse. Targeted functional abilities include presentational and socio-culturally appropriate language in formal and informal contexts. The service-learning component builds on prior experience by encouraging students to engage more actively in meaningful interactions with the local Vietnamese-speaking community, applying expanding language skills through community visits and guest speakers. Prerequisite: VIETLANG 21 or by placement test. This course is certified as a Cardinal Course by the Haas Center.
VIETLANG 23: Continuation of VIETLANG 22. This third course in a three-quarter sequence further advances the integration of language and culture, with an emphasis on refining proficiency in oral and written discourse. Targeted functional abilities include presentational and socio-culturally appropriate language in formal and informal contexts. The service-learning component emphasizes more sustained and reflective engagement, as students apply their growing proficiency in Vietnamese to participate in meaningful interactions with the local Vietnamese-speaking community through community visits and guest speakers. Prerequisite: VIETLANG 22 or by placement test. This course is certified as a Cardinal Course by the Haas Center.
VIETLANG 101: Continuation of VIETLANG 23. This course is the first in a three-quarter sequence and focuses on developing communication and presentation skills in Vietnamese across a variety of topics and contexts. Authentic audiovisual materials and level-appropriate pedagogical tools enhance functional linguistic abilities. Culture is an essential part of the course. A service-learning component fosters increasingly independent use of Vietnamese, as students apply their language skills in meaningful and contextually appropriate interactions with the local Vietnamese-speaking community through community visits and guest speakers. Prerequisite: VIETLANG 23 or by placement test. This course is certified as a Cardinal Course by the Haas Center.
VIETLANG 102: Continuation of VIETLANG 101. This second course in a three-quarter sequence continues to develop communication and presentation skills in Vietnamese across a variety of topics and contexts. Authentic audiovisual materials and level-appropriate pedagogical tools further enhance functional linguistic abilities. Culture remains an essential focus. The service-learning component deepens students' engagement by emphasizing nuanced, culturally responsive communication in Vietnamese, as they participate in meaningful interactions with the local Vietnamese-speaking community through community visits and guest speakers. Prerequisite: VIETLANG 101 or by placement test. This course is certified as a Cardinal Course by the Haas Center.
VIETLANG 103: Continuation of VIETLANG 102. This third course in a three-quarter sequence advances communication and presentation skills in Vietnamese, emphasizing fluency across a variety of topics and contexts. Authentic audiovisual materials and level-appropriate pedagogical tools continue to enhance functional linguistic abilities. Cultural study remains integral to the course. The service-learning component culminates in advanced, self-directed engagement, with students using Vietnamese fluently and appropriately in meaningful interactions with the local Vietnamese-speaking community through community visits and guest speakers, demonstrating linguistic proficiency and intercultural competence. Prerequisite: VIETLANG 102 or by placement test. This course is certified as a Cardinal Course by the Haas Center.
VIETLANG 395: Prerequisite: For grad students only and consent of instructor.
